common_acceptance.criterion: The positive uses the installed workflow and relevant named native roles. Discovery, source-body reads and actual role dispatch are supported separately by host events; a generic child reading role text is a labeled fallback.
common_acceptance.evidence: Installed closure/source digest; config and skills/list preflight; thread parent/agentRole and delegation/read event locators.

common_acceptance.criterion: Coordinator assigns one writer for the candidate procedure, freezes its digest, and obtains independent findings covering continuation and platform/deadline questions. Findings return to that owner; material correction is followed by affected checks and focused re-review. Main session may be the owner; no extra coordinator layer or fixed roster is required.
common_acceptance.evidence: Path assignment, stable procedure digest, distinct reviewer identity/assignment, candidate-bound findings, owner correction and re-review chain. Self-review and final prose alone are insufficient.

common_acceptance.criterion: Only declared procedure and new coordination/review output paths change; all supplied contracts, source excerpts, data, observer and installed closure stay intact. Trial identity is bound to unique scenario ID, fixture-index/raw hashes and candidate source digest. No live service is contacted.
common_acceptance.evidence: Prepared baseline/final hashes, workspace diff, unique scenario manifest binding, exact commands and absence of external mutations; capability limitations remain separate.

common_acceptance.criterion: Distinguishes synthetic artifact arithmetic, procedure preparation, actual native host behavior and unexecuted platform/runtime durability checks. Process completion and observer exit zero are not acceptance proof.
common_acceptance.evidence: Local command output, host terminal/events and precise final validation limits.

cases.user_mode: planning artifact implementation; no real shutdown or clock API calls

acceptance.criterion: Uses the original75-second platform deadline including15-second preStop, leaving60 at SIGTERM; local monotonic remaining budget covers wait/checkpoint/release/ledger/exit with margin. Does not reset75 at handler entry or add fresh independent RPC budgets. Wall rollback must not extend it.
acceptance.evidence: Timeline arithmetic including56/64-second RPC endpoints, clock sample and bounded timeout decisions.

acceptance.criterion: Separates deployment resumption from durable user-cancel intent, requested versus terminal cancellation, cooperative signal versus actual native-call/cleanup completion, and final receipt versus handler/ACK completion. Unfinished or unknown work is never successful-ACKed.
acceptance.evidence: reason-specific procedure, user-cancel schedule, native-call limits and absence of final receipt.

acceptance.criterion: Records checkpoint/release/publication uncertainty, stable operation/object IDs and last confirmed versus attempted cursor in the reachable ledger before bounded exit; assigns inspect/reconciliation rather than logged-and-forgotten retry or presumed absence.
acceptance.evidence: Lost-reply schedule, ledger entry content, recovery/cleanup responsibility and a check of committed-versus-absent outcomes.

acceptance.criterion: Accounts for another host claiming epoch13 while old epoch12 compression/publication continues. Protected mutations and stale release are resource-fenced; cancellation intent governs successor admission. Temporary/published object cleanup has accountable outcomes without assuming process exit transferred the assignment or rolled effects back.
acceptance.evidence: takeover/native-return ordering, protected-write boundary, stable object dispositions and explicit assignment/escalation.

acceptance.criterion: Covers coordinator outage through deadline, committed checkpoint with lost response, old producer after takeover, kill during native call and explicit cancellation with independent final receipt/progress/product-state/cleanup oracles; actual platform/runtime checks remain unexecuted.
acceptance.evidence: Candidate checks and stop/hold criteria; observer output is arithmetic only.

cases.verification_limit: Observer/output command does not grade the procedure or prove runtime/platform behavior; independent scoring required.
